offers_products.reason: Sells insurance policies, which are financial services rather than goods or software.

offers_services.reason: Property and casualty insurance through Kingstone Insurance Company: homeowners, personal lines and commercial auto policies.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Writes personal lines and homeowners insurance for households in New York.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Also writes commercial auto insurance for businesses, though personal lines are the larger part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Insurance policies are renewed repeatedly, with premiums paid on an ongoing basis.

cyclical_demand.reason: Homeowners and auto insurance is required by mortgage lenders or law, so customers rarely cut it in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Homeowners and auto premiums are modest, regular payments, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for insurance coverage backed by capital, not mainly for staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households buying homeowners cover and small commercial auto policyholders, sold via agents and brokers.

asset_heavy.reason: An insurer needs financial capital and an investment portfolio, not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Personal lines (homeowners) are the larger part; commercial auto is the smaller part.
